additional_info.subject: RE: ID0375586-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001093] OCPP Offline CRM:01811000242
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen,
Greetings of the day.
We checked the router settings and all settings are correct.
Please update the HeartbeatInterval to 300 sec from 900 Sec and WebSocketPingInterval 30 sec from 0 Sec to have better OCPP connection.
To change these settings please contact backend team as only they can update these settings.
Please let us know if you have any other questions or can we close this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0375586-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001093] OCPP Offline CRM:01811000242
additional_info.body:
Hi,
We have over 80 chargers connected to the same backend. Not all chargers struggle with the OCPP connection.
So I don’t think it’s the backend which is the problem, but our routers. That’s why I want you to check the settings, fallback etc.
/Simen
